title: bugbot preflight plan
description: preflight.json: how this pull request could be prepared and checked locally, if at all. Written by the triage agent from what the repository documents on its base branch; read by the person and, later, by local checks. A plan only: nothing in it has been executed. Fetch deletes it when the PR's head changes: a plan here is always for the current head.

outcome.description: none: nothing in the diff benefits from running anything. blocked: the PR touches a file that decides what runs (triage local_exec, or a setup step's own source). proposed: steps below, each backed by a quote from the repository. unknown: the repository does not document how to prepare or check it.

reason.description: One line on why this outcome, in terms of the diff and the repository: what changed and what the repository documents.

sources.description: Files read to learn how the repository is prepared and checked, all from the base branch.

ref.description: Commit it was read at (meta.json knowledge.ref).

steps.description: Ordered steps to prepare and check the worktree; empty unless outcome is proposed.

id.description: Short name, unique in the plan (setup, unit-tests...).

purpose.description: setup prepares the worktree (dependencies, toolchain); the others produce a result about the change.

command.description: The command as the repository documents it, narrowed only by dropping targets or paths that cover no changed file.

cwd.description: Directory to run it in, relative to the worktree root; . for the root.

why.description: Which changed files this step exercises, or what later step needs it.

source.description: Where the repository documents this command: a file read from the base and the sentence or line quoted verbatim.

reuses.description: Caches outside the worktree the step can reuse without changing its result (a build tool's own cache, a package manager's download cache). Never dependency directories of the clone.

cost.description: Rough cost on a developer machine: low (seconds), medium (minutes), high (many minutes or gigabytes).

covers.description: Changed files the proposed steps exercise.

uncovered.description: Changed files that are built, executed or type-checked and no step exercises: reviewed by reading only. Never prose, images or binaries.

blocked_by.description: Changed files that block running anything: triage local_exec.denied_by, plus any file a step's source or command depends on that the PR changes.
